request.text: Strangers bring the burning. One trade, then go. Keep that ember in your pocket while you're in our street. If you're going where I think you're going, take bread. Take two. Linnet. Tell my brother I'm alive. He thinks the walls ate me too. He went looking for the sight our grandfather had for one summer. I stayed for the people who lived through it.
request.voice_description: Native English, British, a soft Northern English accent. Female, 30-40. Excellent quality. Persona: an ordinary woman of a town or a besieged kingdom, a villager at her door, a king's granddaughter who stayed with her people. Emotion: wary, tired, kind underneath, quietly brave. A clear, warm, natural mid-pitched voice, plain and conversational; easy to listen to, with no strong character of its own, so it can be many women.
